why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Each one can be checked at the PR head. The three CLI output lines each have a `run` proof (`od -c` plus `PIPESTATUS`) that checks the exact bytes and the exit code. The missing-name line has a `run` proof that sends stdout and stderr to separate files and checks for exit=2, an empty out.txt and a usage line. It allows either `usage: greet <name>` or a usage line naming --shout, but a careful reader can still tell which case applies. The docs line is checked by reading docs/index.md "at the PR head", not the live site. The test line runs `npm test` and reads test/greet.test.js. The live site is the one thing that exists only after merge, and the output moves it to non_goals: "That only happens after merge… This issue only needs docs/index.md updated in the PR." No line needs a deploy or release.
